text:
Noah R: quick note  saw a jump in 'contact_admin_flag' sparsity for SMB accounts after yesterday's import window. About ~1.8k rows now NULL.
Imani G: saw it too. The importer v2 ignores empty prefs and doesn't write default flags. Probably the new 'lean-write' option.
Owen V: Can we avoid reimport? Prefer a lightweight reconcile that sets admin_flag = 'unknown' and adds audit tag.
Noah R: Agreed. Also want to make sure healthscore calc doesn't treat NULL same as 0. It currently lowers score for NULL and triggers false renewal-risk.
Imani G: simple patch: in healthscore func treat NULL as neutral and prefer explicit unknown. I'll patch codec in compute_healthscore().
Owen V: SQL to sample affected cohort:
```
SELECT id, company, account_tier, admin_flag FROM contacts
WHERE admin_flag IS NULL AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
LIMIT 1000;
```
Noah R: ops-bot can we run a dry-run backfill that tags rows and writes to a staging table first?
ops-bot: queued job 'staging-adminflag-backfill-1845678901' scheduled 2025-07-12T09:30Z. Dry-run will write diffs to s3://cs-backfills/dryrun/1845678901.json
Imani G: if dry-run looks good, rollout plan: 1) canary 0.5% -> 5% -> 100% across 3 hours, 2) emit metrics cs.adminflag.backfill.count and cs.healthscore.delta.p50, 3) abort if error >0.3% or median health delta > 0.2.
Noah R: add playbook change too: importer should set explicit unknown for missing flags and playbook should have reconcile after import. I can open a PR.
Owen V: Also add an owner-nudge run: only notify CS owners if account health drops by >0.5 after backfill. Avoid noisy pings.
playbook-bot: playbook 'adminflag-reconcile-v1' proposed (dry-run enabled). Review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playbooks/pull/533
Noah R: sandbox dry-run results: 1,812 rows would be backfilled, median healthscore delta +0.01, no null names, logs clean.
Imani G: PR merged with tests for compute_healthscore null semantics. Will deploy to canary after ops oversight.
Owen V: good. Once canary passes, I'll schedule full backfill and add a short CS note to owners explaining the minor drift.
Noah R: thanks team. I'll write a one-paragraph blameless note and action items in the CS ops board. :white_check_mark:
